efforts.source: Claude desktop app session-management tool schema (set_session_effort enum), observed 2026-09-25; transcripts record the value per assistant turn in `effort`

transcripts.subagent_turn: file <session>/subagents/agent-<agentId>.jsonl, events carry sessionId (parent), agentId, isSidechain=true

units.work_tokens: input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + output_tokens (fresh compute; thinking is inside output)
units.cache_read_tokens: reported separately; not added into work_tokens
units.prompt_size: input + cache_read + cache_creation of one turn = context the model received on that turn (Root context proxy)
units.subscription_caps: NOT observable from transcripts — weekly all-models cap and nested Fable cap are UI-only; record UI readings with quota_reading events

api_reference.table: anthropic-list-price-ratio v1 (from NNC-AI-OSer 1.x): opus/fable 15/75, sonnet 3/15, haiku 0.8/4 USD per MTok; cache read 0.1x input, cache write 1.25x input
api_reference.use: OPTIONAL reference only (`--api-reference`); never subscription cost, never scheduler economics

model_families.source: family token of the model id in transcripts (claude-<family>-<gen>)
